profile.description: Redistributable initramfs with no firmware at all. On ps4-linux-loader >= v24b the 8 core GPU microcode files and the EDID are extracted from the console at boot; hardware video decode/encode (UVD/VCE) and Wi-Fi/BT stay unavailable until firmware is installed.
profile.name: firmware-free

self_check: ok   root= set, appears after 3 polls         => fsck /dev/sdb2;mount root=LABEL=ORBIS-ROOT;
ok   root= set, old psxitarch disk present    => fsck /dev/sdb2;mount root=LABEL=ORBIS-ROOT;
ok   root= set, never appears                 => EERROR root=LABEL=ORBIS-ROOT did not appear within 30s.;mount root=LABEL=ORBIS-ROOT;
redistribution_note: all included firmware is marked redistributable in manifests/firmware.json
loader_note: ps4-linux-loader@d0f4d4c (ps4-kexec-common/firmware.c) extracts 8 of these files (pfp, me, ce, mec, mec2, rlc, sdma, sdma1) from the running console at kexec time and places its cpio BEFORE the operator initramfs; files with the same path in the initramfs replace the extracted ones. liverpool_uvd.bin and liverpool_vce.bin are NOT extracted by the loader: hardware video decode/encode needs them in the initramfs.
